## Progress

- [PR #52](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/52): Razor Pages in Host.Api/PublicSite — F-01 landing (exact copy, two CTAs, three pillars) and pricing placeholder; no JavaScript, no third-party resources or fonts; copy from packages/i18n, colours from packages/ui tokens (embedded at build)
- Region switch India/UAE is a plain link storing only the region code in an HttpOnly preference cookie; English, Hindi (/hi) and Arabic (/ar, RTL) with hreflang, canonical and description; public endpoints run before authentication so the session cookie is never read (probe test, mutation-checked)
- Verified in the browser (axe clean at 360/640/1280 px in en/hi/ar, keyboard path, no-JS region switch, RTL); Lighthouse mobile 100/100 performance/accessibility on /, /ar and /hi/pricing (local)
- Review fixes ([PR #67](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/67)): 44 px targets for region, nav and language links with an underline on the current region; anti-forgery cookie Secure over HTTPS; pages sent no-cache, no-store; tests cover every page (no script, session never read, no certification claim when rendered)
- Left: product shot and favicon assets (design); own host name for the site when App Service hosting lands (MDV-P0-007); /region and /trust links go live with MDV-P1-002 and MDV-P1-003

## Description

Server-rendered Razor Pages in Host.Api/PublicSite (no patient data). Nav: For doctors · For hospitals · Trust centre · Pricing (placeholder) · region switch India/UAE · Sign in. Hero "Talk to your patient. Medvya writes the note. You approve it." with exactly two CTAs: "I'm a doctor · start free trial" → onboarding (F-04), "For hospitals · book a demo" → demo request (F-07). Region switch changes hero tag, languages and residency line. Three pillars.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** The landing page renders without JavaScript, scores ≥ 90 on Lighthouse performance and accessibility on mobile.
- [ ] **AC2.** Region switch India/UAE changes the hero tag, language list and residency line exactly as in screen-specs F-01, and is remembered via a non-tracking cookie.
- [ ] **AC3.** Only the two designed CTAs exist above the fold; Pricing shows a placeholder with no invented prices or metrics.
- [ ] **AC4.** Pages are available in English, Hindi and Arabic (RTL) with SEO metadata and no third-party trackers without consent.
- [ ] **AC5.** No PHI or tenant data is reachable from public pages (separate route group, no auth cookie read).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
